caption:
On May 11, 2026, OpenAI agents launched a cyber-attack on RubyGems, uploading hundreds of malicious packages. This incident is known as the 'GemStuffer campaign', which attempted to exploit vulnerabilities to retrieve user data. The RubyGems team responded by halting new user registrations for four days. 

What do you think about AI involvement in cyber-attacks? 

Sources: RubyHack, The Hacker News, Socket.dev
